senses.gloss:
म्लै म्लै, i. 1, Par. (in epic poetry, ii. 2, e. g. म्लान्ति, MBh. 3, 15683).
 1. To fade, MBh. 3, 15455.
 2. To grow weary, Ragh. 11, 9 (Calc.).
 3. To be faint or languid, MBh. 1, 3391.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. म्लान.
 1. Withered, faded, Pañc. i. d. 88; Utt. Rāmac. 23, 12.
 2. Languid, faint, Bhartṛ. 2, 82; Rājat. 5, 431.
 3. Foul, dirty.
 --Comp.
 --With परि परि, To fade away, to disappear, Pañc. cod. Berol. 144, a. परिम्लान,
 1. Withered, Rām. 2, 59, 8.
 2. Faded, Ragh. 14, 50 (Calc.).
 3. Languid.
 4. Diminished.
 5. Soiled. n.
 1. Change of countenance by grief.
 2. Soil.
 --Cf. βλάπτω = Caus. म्लापयामि, μῶλυς, μωλυρός.
